chalkboard.description: Large classroom chalkboard mounted on the front wall (+Z). Faces towards -Z into classroom.

teacherDesk.description: Teacher's podium/desk positioned directly in front of the chalkboard slightly to the left (-X).

cinematicAisleView.description: Atmospheric autumn viewpoint positioned in the door-side aisle (student row 1-2). Blackboard is centered; Teacher's desk is anchored at bottom-left; Windows & Godrays stream in warmly from right.

straightCentricView.description: Orthogonal front-facing perspective from row 3 student seat looking directly at board center.
